verdicts.evidence: An AST-based audit of the released code found 19 registered tools (≥10), 8 skill documents, implementations for all 8 pipeline stages, and a Claude Agent SDK streaming loop with a stepwise tool-use system prompt. However, the pipeline was never executed end-to-end, the ReAct loop is delegated to Claude SDK rather than locally implemented, and the 'first' priority claim was not evaluated.

No execution was performed: the required model claude-sonnet-4-20250514 is retired, the 306 original traces and predictions are not released, and the repository provides no automatic success judge. Source-concordance string matching only confirms the paper text contains the numbers.

An independent JSONL parser on sp_bench.jsonl found 102 records with 102 unique IDs and queries, 18 categories, 8 stages, and tier counts exactly matching {basic:40, intermediate:28, advanced:21, challenging:13}. Schema, stage-count, placeholder, and tier-complexity consistency checks all passed.

The released evaluator implements the five metric families, but the official dataset lacks CRC-CODEX evaluation inputs, generated quantification outputs, and the complete ground-truth bundle needed to recompute the reported 0.953/0.902/0.368 values. No metrics were recalculated.

Four ground-truth files covering 2,013,525 rows pass structural schema checks, but original agent predictions are absent, so the reported 0.681 average similarity cannot be recomputed. The evaluator also exhibits row-order sensitivity and one ground-truth file has repeated cellLabel values, noted as qualifications.

overall: The logbook independently verifies the SP-Bench benchmark composition (102 queries, 18 categories, 8 stages, exact tier split) and partially confirms the agent architecture via static code audit (19 tools, 8 stage modules, Claude SDK loop with stepwise prompt). The three numerical performance claims (execution accuracy, CRC-CODEX metrics, annotation similarity) remain unverified because original traces, predictions, and evaluation inputs are missing and no experiments were executed.
